rules.summary: Children under 16 may work at most 8 hours in any 12-hour period, 5 a.m.-10 p.m. on nights before a school day (midnight otherwise).

citation.title: Wyo. Stat. § 27-6-110 — Children; hours of labor
citation.excerpt: for more than eight (8) hours in any twelve (12) hour period, or before the hour of five (5:00) o'clock a.m. or after the hour of ten (10:00) o'clock p.m. on nights followed by a school day

rules.summary: Children under 16 may work at most 8 hours in any 12-hour period, 5 a.m.-midnight on nights not followed by a school day.
